WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM matched
), above_average AS (
  SELECT m.instownpct, m.ordertypedist, o.avg_ownership
  FROM matched AS m
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership
)
SELECT AVG(a.instownpct) AS average_ownership,
       AVG(a.instownpct / type_avg.avg_ownership) AS average_ratio_to_type_average,
       AVG(a.instownpct - a.avg_ownership) AS average_excess_overall
FROM above_average AS a
JOIN (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
) AS type_avg
  ON type_avg.ordertypedist = a.ordertypedist;
